faq: What products does SSS Import Export supply?
We supply onion, fresh vegetables, fruits, grains, rice, spices and dehydrated powders, along with refurbished machines, chemicals, plastics and other products sourced from anywhere to anywhere.
Do you export onions from India?
Yes. Onion is our core product. We export red and pink onions in all sizes and grades, from premium 50 to 60 mm double patti to budget grades.
Which countries do you supply to?
We supply across India and export to UAE (Dubai), Malaysia, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Australia and other countries worldwide.
